subject: Closure-to-Live sequencing: MAP + Eval Plan for Zenexus rollout
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenexus.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Closure-to-Live sequencing: MAP + Eval Plan for Zenexus rollout

Daniel —

Thanks again for signing. Attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation sequence, evaluation checklist, and the canary/migration lanes we discussed. High-level ask: confirm owners and the canary window so the services & training teams lock resources.

Key items in the attached MAP_Zenexus_v1.xlsx and EvalChecklist: 
- Canary window (proposal): Oct 18–22 (3 rolling days + buffer).
- Migration lanes: lane A (pilot data subset, rep-level routing), lane B (full tenant traffic).
- Training: 2-day train-the-trainers (Oct 12–13) + 3 weekly enablement drop-ins post-go-live.
- Acceptance tests: throughput baseline + p99 latency target < 200ms for 4k token sequences, throttled load test to 50 rps for canary period.
- Eval harness: automated prompt-suite + regression alert hooks; results published to shared Drive folder.
- Rollback thresholds: >5% error rate increase OR p99 latency > 2x baseline => immediate rollback.

Operational notes: we'll prewarm KV caches and stage quantization parity checks in the staging cluster 72 hours before the first canary. Smart routing will route 5% -> 25% -> 100% by acceptance gates. We'll provide a runbook (operations + rollback steps) and a one-click fallback to the hosted model pool.

Please review the attached MAP and EvalChecklist. Specifically, confirm:
1) Canary window feasibility on your side.
2) POC for acceptance testing (who owns sign-off).
3) Any procurement / legal hold-ups we should queue into the MAP (HubSpot deal and contract tasks attached).

Provided attachments: MAP_Zenexus_v1.xlsx (implementation lanes), Zenexus_EvalChecklist.pdf (detailed tests). Drive link with live files: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cZENEXUS-MAP

If the proposed canary window works, we'll dispatch a services statement of work and lock trainer dates by EOD next week.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

[Attachment: MAP_Zenexus_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: Zenexus_EvalChecklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenexus.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.m@zenexus.com>, Procurement <procurement@zenexus.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Closure-to-Live sequencing: MAP + Eval Plan for Zenexus rollout

Karthik —

Appreciate the thorough MAP. A few immediate notes from our side: 
1) Canary window: we prefer Oct 11–13 given other platform commitments the week of Oct 18. Can you confirm the team's availability?
2) Data residency & evidence: we'll need SOC2 evidence and a short inventory of logging/audit retention (30/90/365 day options) in the MAP before procurement signs off. I've attached the SOC2 evidence request template used by our security team.
3) Acceptance owner: tagging Asha as application owner; she will nominate the testing lead by Friday.

We'll also want the eval harness to include a small set of synthetic prompts that reflect our high-frequency transactions and an outlier detection metric for hallucination.

Quick note on rollback: can we add a canary failover to a warmed quantized variant with a 1s increase budget rather than a full rollback? That would reduce user impact while we triage.

I'll review the MAP with Procurement and loop back with any redlines.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
VP Product, Zenexus Health
daniel.park@zenexus.com
[Attachment: SOC2_evidence_request.docx (docx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenexus.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Closure-to-Live sequencing: MAP + Eval Plan for Zenexus rollout

Daniel —

Thanks — great feedback.

Adjustments we've made in MAP_V1.1 (attached):
- Updated canary window option A: Oct 11–13; option B: Oct 18–22 (kept as fallback). Please mark which you prefer.
- Added SOC2 evidence checklist and audit retention table (Laura — can you confirm retention SLA choices and upload the evidence links?).
- Eval harness: Marissa will own the initial prompt-suite and synthetic transactions; she'll share the first-run report by Oct 6.
- Canary failover: agreed — we'll add a warmed quantized variant (quant-q8) as intermediate fallback. Runbook updated with 1s degradation budget and an escalation path to on-call infra.

Laura / Marissa — can you confirm the procurement items and services SOW timeline? I flagged the HubSpot deal (ZEN-4721) and added procurement milestones to the MAP.

Daniel/Asha — once you confirm the canary window and acceptance owner, we'll convert MAP_v1.1 into the living document and schedule the kickoff.

Best,
Karthik

[Attachment: MAP_Zenexus_v1.1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Asha Menon <asha.m@zenexus.com>

Thanks team —

We confirm Oct 11–13 canary window. I'll be the acceptance owner and nominate Ramesh Kumar as testing lead (cc'd in a follow-up). Procurement has the SOC2 checklist and will queue evidence requests; expect a response by EOD Monday.

Also confirm training window Oct 5–6 for our internal trainers (this gives them a week to prep before canary). Weekly 30-minute syncs on Wednesdays at 10am PT works for our stakeholders.

Asha
